text: Excursion to Montserrat with Marta and Lucía. We left very early and halfway there I realized I hadn't looked at my phone for hours because there was no signal. Up there, looking at everything, I felt something I hadn't felt in a long time: that I was truly alive, not just going through the days. We talked about the future. Lucía wants to change jobs and Marta asked me what I would do if I weren't afraid. I told her I would teach the app. So I've decided: before November, I will show it to five friends, even if it's not perfect. I'm saying it out loud so I can't back out.
points: I went on an excursion to Montserrat.
I felt truly alive during the excursion.
I decided to show the app to five friends before November.
I am committing to not back out of my decision.
